title: athyrium fontanum
intro: Athyrium fontanum, commonly known as Lady fern, is a species of flowering plant in the fern family. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium fontanum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Lady fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
